accounting_note: Outer timer/context setup and teardown (microseconds) assigned to orchestration; measured conversion phase spans unchanged.
platform: Windows x64, Abaqus 2025 HF1, bundled Python 3.10.5 / NumPy 1.22.4
method: Three fresh processes per fixture per mode, sequential alternating order. Representative phase table uses the median-total profiled sample; exclusive phases add to its workflow time. Control and instrumented artifacts compared byte-for-byte.
scope: open -> optional history -> frame VTUs -> PVD -> close; imports and launcher startup excluded from workflow time and recorded separately. No cold OS cache guarantee.
